title: Development and internal validation of machine-learning models for postoperative deep vein thrombosis after hip arthroplasty for femoral neck fracture: evaluation of Traditional Chinese Medicine syndr
summary: retrospective single-center cohort n=380; profile-disjoint holdout n=113/31 DVT events. RF AUC .859 in one held-out partition but mean .792 over 30 repeated constrained partitions; adding two TCM syndrome features did not improve AUC (0.855 vs 0.859, p=.746); TyG association remains observational.
